keySentence: Greed always destroys more than it gives back to us.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Greedy pirates became weak. Jim's team stayed strong together. Friends are the real treasure. Greed always destroys more than it gives back to us.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The greedy pirates grew weaker because they could not trust each other. Jim's group stayed strong because they worked as a team. This story teaches us that people matter more than gold. Friendship is worth more than any treasure chest. Greed always destroys more than it gives back to us. Jim understood that the real treasure was the people beside him.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: By the end of the week, the consequences of greed had become painfully obvious. The pirates, consumed by their desire for gold, had turned on each other completely. Their group was falling apart because selfishness destroys all bonds of trust. Meanwhile, Jim's companions grew stronger through their generosity and mutual support. Greed always destroys more than it gives back to us. However, the most important lesson was not about winning or losing a battle. Because Jim witnessed both greed and generosity up close, he understood a deep truth. The greatest treasure in life is not gold or jewels but the people who stand by your side.
